This fixture is a trimmed subset of `langchain-ai/openwiki`'s `openwiki/` folder at commit `db1c0f06fce1a8116bd76a28598a33d57f6cbe81`, used under the MIT license in `LICENSE-openwiki`. It keeps the root index and instructions, two concept pages (`okf-output.md` and `two-modes.md`) with their directory index, one workflow page (`wiki-finalization.md`) with its directory index, and one small Claims sidecar (`.claims/concepts/two-modes.json`); the rest of the real bundle (architecture, integrations, operations, testing, `quickstart.md`, and the remaining concepts and workflows) was left out to keep the fixture small. The `extra/` folder is hand-written test data, not from OpenWiki, and is copied over `openwiki/` at test time.
